content: osxphotos issue #1651 (RhetTbull): Photos.sqlite table/column names (_DB_TABLE_NAMES) are hardcoded per-version and change with almost every macOS release (broke again in 14.6); the fix direction is self-discovering schema via sqlite_master introspection (e.g. regex-matching 'Z_%KEYWORDS' tables) rather than hardcoded names, plus an osxphotos dbversion command to report schema version without fully parsing. Confirms Photos is the least stable of the sqlite-backed stores this repo would read.
